_comment: Hand-curated (2026-10-02). All 63 Québec zecs, each linking to its own website on the Réseau Zec network. We link, never rehost: the official 1:40 000 territory maps are free in Avenza Maps and on the Réseau Zec cartothèque, and a few zecs post a PDF on their own site, but no zec states a licence (reseauzec.com: "Tous droits réservés"), so no map file is linked directly and nothing enters the download catalog until Réseau Zec agrees. Research and per-zec map URLs: docs/research/zec-maps.md. Activities are assigned by type in build-manifest (see docs/CATALOG.md).
